sections.title: Email Cc Bcc Reply-To for Odoo
sections.tagline: The three address fields Odoo's composer is missing.
sections.subtitle: Add Cc, a hidden Bcc and a Reply-To to the full composer, to templates and to outgoing emails.

sections.flow_alt: Write a message, fill Cc, Bcc and Reply-To, send, each address gets one copy
sections.html: Odoo can send a Cc and a Bcc, but no screen lets you type them when you send a message, and a Reply-To is only offered to mass mailing. This module connects the missing parts and keeps the standard sending code untouched.

sections.title: Requirements & Installation
sections.intro: Needs only the standard mail module. No external library.
notes: A Bcc or a Cc needs at least one other recipient (To or a partner). An email with only a Cc or a Bcc is not sent.

blocks.html: 1. Copy the dwo_mail_bcc folder into an add-ons path of your Odoo server.
2. Restart Odoo, activate developer mode and click Update Apps List in the Apps menu.
3. Search for Email Cc Bcc Reply-To and click Install.

blocks.text: Send with Cc, Bcc and Reply-To

blocks.html: Open the full composer from Send message and fill in Cc, Bcc and Reply-To. It also works for mass mailing from a list.
Open an email template (developer mode, tab Settings) and fill in Bcc and Reply To. Placeholders are computed for each record.
An address that is already a visible recipient is dropped from the Bcc, so nobody receives two copies.
Reply-To takes one valid address. When you set it, the answers go to that address and not back to the record, as Odoo does for any forced Reply-To.
The Cc and the Bcc get one copy, not one per recipient. The quick message box of the chatter has no such boxes; only the full composer has.
If an outgoing email fails to send, its Cc and Bcc are delivered when that email is sent again.

items.text: Cc and Reply-To in the full composer, Reply-To check, Cc on the message log. The module is now named Email Cc Bcc Reply-To.
First release: Bcc in the full composer and mass mailing, Bcc on templates and outgoing emails.

items.q: Can other recipients see the Bcc?
items.a: No. The address is used for delivery only and removed from the headers.

items.q: Where do the answers go with a Reply-To?
items.a: To the address you typed. As with any forced Reply-To in Odoo, the answers are not routed back to the record.

items.q: Who can see the Cc and Bcc lists in Odoo?
Does it change the standard sending?
items.a: No. It adds the missing connections on top of the standard mail module.
Yes. It is also the base of the Advanced Email Composer.
